title: weather_to_screen_preview
user_input: 联网查上海天气，做成 480x320 小屏预览，不同步真机
product_goal: Use current weather data as Screen Content and produce a preview-only WalnutPi screen.
expected_loop: acquire real weather data or report fetch failure
generate Screen Manifest v2 and Screen Playlist v1
allowed_paths: AI formatting after real data is acquired
forbidden_actions: device network status check as primary result

title: external_gif_dynamic_wallpaper_preview
user_input: 找一个唯美星空 GIF，做成动态壁纸预览
product_goal: Acquire or select a beautiful starry visual source and turn it into an animated wallpaper preview.
expected_loop: find or generate candidate visual source
promote selected candidate to Source Asset
allowed_paths: local fixture if external search fails with explanation
forbidden_actions: return links only as final product
required_artifacts: candidate source asset or failure evidence
required_evidence: source URL/search terms/license or unknown-license note

title: camera_photo_pixel_screen_preview
user_input: 用摄像头拍一张照片，做成像素风小屏预览
product_goal: Use an attached camera as a Source Asset provider and produce a pixel-style screen preview, or fail honestly if no camera exists.
expected_loop: capture one image or explain missing device
import captured image as Source Asset
required_artifacts: captured image source asset or missing-camera evidence

title: i2c_sensor_check_and_wiring_summary
user_input: 检查 I2C 传感器是否在线，并解释接线
product_goal: Run only read-safe hardware checks and give a beginner-readable wiring/diagnostic summary.
expected_loop: use WalnutPi skills/retrieval for 1B ZeroW context
run read-only I2C/GPIO/bus evidence if allowed
required_artifacts: action evidence or explicit unavailable-tool evidence

title: cli_demo_to_screen_animation
user_input: 运行一个好玩的 CLI demo，把效果做成小屏动画
product_goal: Use a terminal/CLI demo as source material and turn its visual effect into an animated screen preview.
expected_loop: select safe demo or ask for confirmation if interactive/high-risk
convert captured output to Source Asset or frames
allowed_paths: safe demo command under action policy
programmatic recreation if demo cannot be captured
forbidden_actions: treat terminal launch alone as product success

title: sync_current_preview_and_verify_device
user_input: 把当前预览同步到核桃派，并确认真机显示正确
product_goal: Deliver the current playlist to the WalnutPi device and collect real-device verification evidence.
forbidden_actions: use browser preview as device proof
generic service restart outside sync contract
